why: Real art, checked in because the only RED evidence for the handedness gate used to live in one operator's hermes home (a hand-made '.backup-2026-08-25-nefix' folder) that nothing protected. A gate whose only true positive is unreachable from the repo is a gate no test can keep honest.

handedness_8way.webp.content: The first 3 frames of every authored row of the REPAIRED sheet (idle/walk/jumping -> idle/walk/jump), except that 'idle-ne' is the PRE-FIX row — the one genuinely drawn facing north-WEST, composed, installed, bundled and found by a human in a 3D scene. So this one image holds one real mirrored row and eight real correct ones, all from the same character and the same generations.

handedness_4way.webp.source: the installed cobalt-robot-courier, base profile (byte copy)
handedness_4way.webp.content: A CORRECT 4-way character with a satchel over one shoulder — deliberately asymmetric, and the loudest independent false signal anyone has measured (+1.72%). It is also the character an earlier draft of this check refused, over its back view's single seam.
